title: The Tenth Man: Adam to Noah, Shem to Abraham, Isaac to Boaz
summary: Under the heading 'The Tenth Man', three columns of ten names each: Adam to Noah, Shem to Abraham, and Isaac to Boaz. The tenth name in each column (Noah, Abraham, Boaz) is shown larger, and a few names are coloured.

text.text: Adam · Seth · Enosh · Kenan · Mahalalel · Jared · Enoch · Methuselah · Lamech · Noah
Shem · Arphaxad · Shelah · Eber · Peleg · Reu · Serug · Nahor · Terah · Abraham
Isaac · Jacob · Judah · Perez · Hezron · Ram · Amminadab · Nahshon · Salmon · Boaz

numbers.note: each column lists ten names; the tenth is Noah, Abraham and Boaz
